title: Way below expected value!
text: Paid 70.00 plus dollars for the standard box , they said box would have a value of 110- 150 . No where near that value , also  they sent a t-shirt and did not ask for my size so useless . Received a t-shirt , hat, small bottle of shampoo , gun mat , deck of cards and a small  blanket. All of the products say club tac  except the hat.
